svg.text: Saved pair consistency — software consistency only
Captured run: E4608-firstgreen | stored overall status: CONSISTENT | 12 rows × 5 stations = 60 records
Stored counts, kept separate: 42 OBSERVED / MATCHED · 18 UNKNOWN / UNKNOWN
Exposed dependent views: crop and source are translated views, NOT independent courses or ground truth.
Physical claims UNKNOWN/HOLD. Symmetric left/right swaps remain invisible to these consistency comparisons.
Already-saved counterexample: 8.090622377680736 px signed offset; NOT a new measurement.
CONSISTENT_AVAILABLE is a row-level software verdict; UNKNOWN stations remain UNKNOWN, not passes or zero values.
Audit-used projection only, NOT the complete original payload. No geometry, rankings or scientific scores recomputed.
Legend: green = retained OBSERVED + MATCHED; amber = retained UNKNOWN + UNKNOWN. Colors do not establish physical truth.
Each exact row ID carries its stored CONSISTENT_AVAILABLE verdict above its five exact station IDs.
No pixels, CV image panels, producer replay, new measurement or geometry calls. Data are copied from the captured result only.
